Error.Title: Something went wrong
Error.Description: Sorry, something on our side did not work. Please try again in a moment.
Error.RequestId: If you tell us about it, this number helps us find it
Error.NotFound.Title: We can't find that page
Error.NotFound.Description: The address may have changed, or the link is an old one. Nothing is broken — the page just isn't here.
Error.Forbidden.Title: This page isn't yours to open
Error.Forbidden.Description: Your login doesn't reach this part of the salon. If you need it, ask the salon's owner.
Error.TooMany.Title: Just a moment
Error.TooMany.Description: That was a lot of tries in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
Error.Other.Title: That didn't work
Error.Other.Description: The request could not be completed. Please go back and try again.
